reason: The last assistant message proposes and initiates a booking-database update (changing XEHM4B from basic economy to business) after already obtaining explicit confirmation, but then adds an unsupported procedural claim: "after this upgrade, cancelling the reservation would only be possible if the cancellation rules are met — upgrading to business would then make it cancellable," which conflicts with the policy because basic economy cannot be modified and cancellation eligibility depends on the listed rules, not on upgrading. It also appears to set up a second action (cancel right after) without a separate confirmation for that update sequence.
